faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before working with us.

items.q: Do you have any minimum requirements to work together?
items.a: We look for businesses that already have a validated product or service and are ready to scale. We recommend a minimum ad spend investment to see significant and profitable results.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: Early indicators (qualified traffic, leads) are seen in the first 7-14 days. However, deep optimization and predictable, scalable ROI takes about 45 to 90 days depending on your industry and sales cycle.

items.q: Do you handle other services besides advertising?
items.a: We specialize 100% in Performance Marketing and Paid Media (Meta Ads, Google Ads). We believe that focusing on one single area allows us to deliver results far superior to those of a generalist traditional agency.

items.q: How is communication during the service?
items.a: We maintain a direct and exclusive channel with your team, where we track progress and resolve doubts quickly. In addition, we send performance reports and organize strategy meetings to align goals.

items.q: Who is in charge of making the creatives (photos/videos)?
items.a: Depending on the plan you choose, we can provide the initial creatives or advise and guide your internal team by delivering proven scripts, references, and guidelines to maximize conversion.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.subtitle: Information about how we handle and protect your personal data in our forms and platforms.
privacy_policy.intro: At Signal Marketing, we take your data privacy very seriously. Below, we detail how we handle the information you share with us through our contact forms, meeting calendars, and advertising campaigns.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: Through our contact forms and channels, we collect the following information: First and last name, Company name, Contact phone number (with international prefix), Description of your business or project, and link to your website and/or social media.

sections.title: 2. Meeting Scheduler (Calendly)
sections.content: To facilitate coordinating consultations and meetings, we integrate Calendly on our website. When scheduling a date and time, the data entered is managed in accordance with Calendly's privacy policies for the sole purpose of coordinating and scheduling the call.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.content: We use the collected information solely to: Contact you to answer your inquiries, analyze the feasibility of your projects prior to our meeting, prepare customized business proposals, and follow up on your service request.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and Advertising (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
sections.content: This website uses tracking technologies and third-party cookies (such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Meta Pixel) to measure the performance of our advertising campaigns and understand how users interact with our site. We do not share direct personal contact information with these networks.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention and Security
sections.content: Your personal data is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for commercial purposes. It is stored securely and confidentially in our internal customer management systems. We will retain it only for as long as necessary to fulfill the business relationship.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.content: At any time, you can request access to, rectification, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us through any of our communication channels or by replying to our emails.
